items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 13 at 2:15PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Rain is expected everyday through the week with periods of heavy
rain likely at times, especially along the southern slopes of the
Eastern Alaska Range on Tuesday and Wednesday. From Monday
afternoon through Thursday morning, rainfall totals will be around
1 to 3 inches with locally higher amounts in the summits above
5000 feet. South winds will also be gusty, up to 45 mph which can
result in localized tree damage. However, wind gusts of 65 to 75
mph will reside just to the north.
items.areas: Southern Denali Borough; Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp

items.description:

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 13 at 1:52PM AKDT until July 15 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 65 mph
expected, and the strongest winds through Tuesday evening.

* WHERE...Northern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Tuesday to 4 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued July 13 at 1:52PM AKDT until July 15 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 40 mph with gusts up to 75 mph possible.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range, north of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Tuesday to 10 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction: Use caution if you must drive.
